//: Type-CHECK only — no emit. tsconfig.json includes `src/**/*.js`, so the hand-written .d.ts roots at src/ are never type-checked by the generation run: a JSX entry could (and did) reference an interface that was never declared and nothing noticed until a consumer compiled it. This config roots src/react.d.ts so that mistake fails `npm run types`. Run on its own with `npm run types:check`.
//2: skipLibCheck MUST stay false here. The files under check are themselves .d.ts, so skipLibCheck would skip exactly them — and false is also the consumer setting under which these declarations get checked at all.
//3: src/index.d.ts and src/global.d.ts are deliberately NOT rooted yet: they pull in the generated component declarations, whose `attributeChangedCallback(name, old, value)` does not match the zero-argument `attributeChangedCallback()` on GaElement. Checking them reports pre-existing TS2416s that belong to their own fix.
